meta.description: A read-only record of when IBM published new properties for ibm_fez, and what changed at each: every distinct calibration stamp from 9 October 2026 00:00 UTC to 14 October 2026 03:20:20 UTC, found by reading the properties dated at 10-minute steps and bisecting every change down to 60 s or less (1,486 reads, no errors), each compared by value with the snapshot before it. No job was run. A stamp is a record of publication, not a measurement on the device.

how_compared: each snapshot against the one before it, by exact equality of the published values (dates aside). Counts are out of 156 qubits and 176 CZ edges: q_T1, q_T2, q_frequency, q_readout_error, q_prob_meas0_prep1 and q_prob_meas1_prep0 count qubits whose value changed; g1_<gate> qubits whose single-qubit gate error changed (g1_any, any of id, rx, rz, sx, x, xslow); cz_error and cz_length edges whose CZ error or length changed in either direction; other_values_changed every other published field that changed (count of entries), and dates_moved the fields whose dates moved. The <field>_dates_* columns give, per snapshot, the distinct dates the T1, T2 and readout values carry. ibm_fez's properties carry no frequency (and no anharmonicity) entry in any snapshot, so q_frequency is 0 throughout because the field is absent: IBM does not publish ibm_fez's qubit frequencies, and a change of frequency would not show here. Row 0 is the last stamp before the window, the baseline
